verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs say you can instrument services with OpenTelemetry for 'platform-agnostic observability' and send that OTel data into New Relic for analysis. That covers the core of the story: instrument once with an open standard, with no lock-in to proprietary agents. The evidence is limited to two short doc statements, with no detail on the ingest mechanism or on how backend switching works in practice. Missing for 10: documented OTLP endpoint/ingest details, explicit guidance on vendor-neutral portability or backend switching, independent or hands-on corroboration.
